requirement.description: Function 'get_annotated_artifact_value' is missing required argument 'artifact_annotation' in call sites, causing TypeError for tests like test_artifact_loading and test_artifact_byte_loading.

The function signature should be: get_annotated_artifact_value(param_name: str, artifact_annotation: Artifact) -> Union[Path, Any].
